findings.detail: This Google Fonts URL (Lora, Inter) has no display parameter, so the rules it returns leave font-display to the browser, which can hide the text for up to about 3 seconds. Rule: set font-display on every web font: swap by default, fallback or optional by choice, block only for icon fonts. Reason: hidden text delays first paint and LCP; fix the shift from a late swap with a metric-matched fallback, not by hiding text. Fix: add "&display=swap" to the URL.

This <link rel="stylesheet"> loads Google Fonts CSS (Lora, Inter) from another origin and blocks rendering until it arrives. Fix: preconnect to https://fonts.googleapis.com and https://fonts.gstatic.com, then load the stylesheet without blocking (media="print" with onload="this.media='all'", plus a <noscript> copy), or self-host the fonts.

This <link rel="stylesheet"> loads Google Fonts CSS (Inter, Bebas Neue) from another origin and blocks rendering until it arrives. Fix: preconnect to https://fonts.googleapis.com and https://fonts.gstatic.com, then load the stylesheet without blocking (media="print" with onload="this.media='all'", plus a <noscript> copy), or self-host the fonts.

"Inter" declares weight 600 here (Google Fonts URL), but nothing in the scanned files sets font-weight 600 where this family could apply. Fix: remove this weight, unless something the scan cannot see applies it (styles set by scripts, CMS content).

This Google Fonts URL (JetBrains Mono) has no display parameter, so the rules it returns leave font-display to the browser, which can hide the text for up to about 3 seconds. Rule: set font-display on every web font: swap by default, fallback or optional by choice, block only for icon fonts. Reason: hidden text delays first paint and LCP; fix the shift from a late swap with a metric-matched fallback, not by hiding text. Fix: add "&display=swap" to the URL.

This @import of Google Fonts CSS (JetBrains Mono) blocks rendering: the browser finds it only after the stylesheet that imports it has downloaded, then waits for another origin. Fix: replace it with a <link rel="stylesheet"> in the HTML head after a preconnect to https://fonts.googleapis.com and https://fonts.gstatic.com, or self-host the fonts.
